votes.motion: Approve the Kroll, 398 Sunset Lane field change request.
votes.quote: a motion by ml was made to approve the filed change. jv seconded and the commission voted unanimously to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Approve the Nick Eaton amendment to Order of Conditions 208-1240 (411 Townsend Harbor Road) with six maples, three in the 30-foot zone and three in the 50-foot zone.
votes.quote: the motion was approved by a 5 to 1 vote with jv dissenting.

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the four-foot fence within the buffer zone at 141 Hemlock Dr.
votes.quote: a motion was made for a negative determination by rb with a second by cc with a unanimous vote to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue a positive determination for the landing and deck within the 100 foot buffer zone at 205 Sunset Lane (Harrison).
votes.quote: a motion was made by rb for a positive determination with a second by jr with a unanimous vote by roll call to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Glenn Maki culvert Notice of Intent (160 Massachusetts Ave) to May 18.
votes.quote: rb moved to continue to may 18 with a second by cc and a unanimous vote to approve

votes.motion: Continue the Fitchburg Land property Owner LLC Notice of Intent (260 Fahlulah Road) to May 18.
votes.quote: the meeting was continued until may 18 by a motion of ml and a second by rb with a unanimous roll call vote approving the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Jason Zirkle request (379 Townsend Harbor Road) to May 18.
votes.quote: ml moved to continue to may 18 with rb seconding and the commission unanimously approved the motion by roll call vote

votes.motion: Issue an order of conditions for the Ken Matson single family home within the buffer zone at 71 Watt St, with a condition that the homeowner be responsible for perpetual maintenance.
votes.quote: ml seconded and the commission vote unanimously by roll call vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the David Blatt tree removal request (411 Goodrich Street) to the May 18 meeting.
votes.quote: this was continued to the may 18th meeting by cc and a second by ml with a unanimous vote to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve the administrator's determination to replant trees at 165 Townsend Harbor Road.
votes.quote: a motion of jr and a second by ml with a unanimous vote to approve by roll call vote

votes.motion: Modify the prior determination at 365 Sunset to allow the remainder of a rotted triple-stem tree to be cut down with one tree replanted.
votes.quote: this was approved by a motion of jr and a second by ml with a unanimous vote to approve by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions for stairs, a landing and a dock within the 100 foot buffer zone at 160 Sunset Lane (Nazarenko).
votes.quote: jv moved to issue an order of conditions. cc seconded and the motion was approved by a vote of 3 for (bp, jc and cc).

votes.motion: Continue the John Welton request (205 Sunset Lane, Map 129 Lot 68) to May 18th.
votes.quote: the motion passed by a vote of 4 to 1 ( ml abstaining)
meeting adjourned at 11:35 pm by a motion of jr and seconded by ml with a unanimous vote of the commission by roll call vote
